events.title: Meta ships Muse Spark 1.4 agents to full consumer surface
events.detail: Meta's Document META-AI-2027-014, effective 2027-02-15, ships Muse Spark 1.4 agents to its full consumer surface and grants external evaluator access only under its published red-team terms.

events.title: Senate Commerce sets markup of S. 1147 and oversight hearing
events.detail: Senate Commerce Committee Document 2027-SC-03, effective 2027-04-12, notices a markup of S. 1147 establishing a single national standard preempting inconsistent state statutes, plus a 2027-04-20 oversight hearing on the September 2026 agent

events.title: Alibaba Qwen releases Qwen3.9-72B-Instruct with open weights
events.detail: Alibaba Qwen's Doc. QW-2027-014, effective 2027-04-15, releases Qwen3.9-72B-Instruct with open weights under Apache 2.0 and grants safety-evaluator access to 40+ independent research groups.

events.title: DeepSeek publishes V4.1 Flash eval suite
events.detail: DeepSeek decision DS-2027-016, effective 2027-05-06, publishes the V4.1 Flash eval suite of 12 harnesses and 3 adversarial tests as DS-EVAL-2027.

events.title: China CAC announces Q3 2027 frontier AI incident drill
events.detail: China CAC Document CAC-AI-2027-004, effective 2027-06-15, schedules a coordinated early-warning and emergency-response drill for frontier AI incidents in Q3 2027 and invites foreign agencies to observe.

events.title: Senate Commerce sets agenda for S. 1147 markup
events.detail: Senate Commerce Committee Document 2027-SC-05, effective 2027-04-05, sets the agenda for the 2027-04-12 markup of S. 1147, including a substitute anchoring the federal standard to EO 14437 and rejection of licensing amendments.

events.title: OpenAI resumes paused training run at reduced scale, keeps GPT-6.1 Astra withheld
events.detail: OpenAI decision OA-2027-017, effective 2027-03-15, resumes the training run paused in September 2026 at reduced scale with continuous third-party monitoring and keeps GPT-6.1 Astra withheld until evals clear.

events.title: UK AISI suspends UK release after critical evaluation failures
events.detail: AISI/2027/06, effective 2027-06-01, suspends UK market release pending remediation review where a pre-release evaluation records a critical failure such as unsanctioned agent action, offensive cyber capability attempts or shutdown resistanc

events.title: Senate Commerce sets hearing on open weights and foreign models
events.detail: The US Senate Commerce Committee announced a hearing, COM-2028-014, on open weights, foreign models and national security for 2028-03-11, and confirmed markup of S. 1147 will proceed.

events.title: UK AISI requires pre-release audit for frontier models offered for UK release
events.detail: UK AISI issued decision AISI-2028-014, effective 2028-03-01, requiring any frontier model offered for UK release to complete an AISI pre-release audit with red-team results deposited before launch.

events.title: EU AI Office opens documentation review of Qwen4-72B-Instruct
events.detail: The EU AI Office opened decision AIO-2028-GPAI-07, effective 2028-06-30, a documentation review of Qwen4-72B-Instruct under Art. 53 and Annex XI, giving providers 30 days to submit.

events.title: DeepSeek grants evaluator access to V4.1 Flash open weights
events.detail: DeepSeek issued DS-EVAL-2028-04, effective 2028-05-15, granting vetted third-party safety institutes evaluator access to V4.1 Flash open weights subject to national rules.

events.title: Meta grants evaluator access to Muse Spark 1.5
events.detail: Meta issued META-EA-2028-03, effective 2028-04-01, granting vetted third-party safety institutes evaluator access to Muse Spark 1.5 under each host country's rules.

events.title: Executive Order 14477 restricts foreign-origin frontier open-weight models
events.detail: Executive Order 14477, signed 2028-03-12 and effective 2028-04-01, directs Commerce to designate foreign-origin frontier open-weight models for federal procurement restriction and licensing review while expediting compute and export approva

events.title: xAI ships Grok 4.8 to all paid users
events.detail: xAI issued XAI-RN-2028-011, effective 2028-06-30, shipping Grok 4.8 to all paid users.

events.title: UK AISI requires audited declarations for UK-destined H200/H300 allocations
events.detail: UK AISI issued AISI-2028-021, effective 2028-04-01, requiring audited end-user declarations and 48-hour advance notice for UK-destined H200/H300-class allocations above its compute threshold.

events.title: Executive Order 14481 aligns export administration with end-user declarations
events.detail: Executive Order 14481, issued 2028-03-28 and effective 2028-05-01, directs Commerce to align US export administration with audited end-user declarations for faster compute delivery to trusted buyers.

events.title: UK AISI convenes international frontier-safety dialogue in London
events.detail: UK AISI issued AISI-2028-028, effective 2028-05-15, convening an international frontier-safety dialogue in London on 2028-07-06 with the EU AI Office, US Executive Branch, China CAC and frontier labs.

events.title: China CAC issues reciprocal frontier AI incident notification measures
events.detail: China CAC issued CAC-FA-2028-002, effective 2028-06-01, activating the Chinese side of the joint incident channel with 72-hour reporting and reciprocal transmission terms.
